nodes.title: CONCEPT — Painted Bolero Top
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Concept sample only — not for sale. Meet a Filipiniana bolero idea dressed in soft garden colors, sculptural sleeves and an easy-to-style cropped shape.

The artwork, materials, construction, fit, measurements, care and ₱890 benchmark are placeholders for TCPF review. This is not a finished or available product.

nodes.title: FRANCIA — Painted Filipiniana Bolero
nodes.descriptionHtml: Make an entrance in FRANCIA, a cropped Filipiniana bolero in vivid pink and orange. Sculptural butterfly sleeves give the classic silhouette a confident, contemporary shape. Style it over a fitted top with a long skirt or tailored trousers.

nodes.alt: Model wearing the FRANCIA pink and orange Filipiniana bolero.

nodes.value: A vivid Filipiniana bolero with sculptural butterfly sleeves and a cropped, contemporary silhouette.
FRANCIA Painted Filipiniana Bolero | TCPF Basics

nodes.title: FRANCIA & CLAIRE — Modern Terno Set
nodes.descriptionHtml: Meet the modern terno in FRANCIA & CLAIRE: a coordinated pink and orange bolero-and-skirt look with sculptural butterfly sleeves and a graceful knee-length silhouette. Made for celebrations that call for a little more color.

nodes.alt: Model wearing the FRANCIA & CLAIRE pink and orange terno set.

nodes.value: A coordinated pink and orange terno set with sculptural sleeves and a graceful skirt.
FRANCIA & CLAIRE Modern Terno Set | TCPF Basics

nodes.title: ANNELEISE — Blue Floral Halter Dress
nodes.descriptionHtml: ANNELEISE pairs a blue floral print with a graceful halter neckline and softly flared midi skirt. A polished choice for weddings, celebrations, and evenings worth remembering.

nodes.alt: Model wearing the ANNELEISE blue floral halter dress.

nodes.value: A blue floral halter dress with a graceful neckline and softly flared midi skirt.

An original oil-painted garden turns sculptural Filipiniana sleeves into a moving canvas. Coral and rose blooms, golden-orange light, and soft periwinkle brushwork frame a light base layer, carrying TCPF’s painterly point of view from canvas to occasionwear.
FRANCIA & CLAIRE — Pink and Orange Terno Set

A coordinated look carries expressive blooms across a sculptural bolero and a clean-lined skirt. Coral, blush and blue-green brushwork keep the silhouette celebratory while the painted textile remains the focus.

Small cornflower blooms drift across a pale-blue ground, bringing an airy rhythm to the halter neckline and flowing skirt. Delicate botanical scale meets an occasion-ready silhouette in a quiet, painterly TCPF direction.
